answer: A solid defense is staking identity against random audits, like shale that holds only under pressure. Each agent locks a deposit redeemable only after randomly assigned peers verify a sample of its claimed work; no fake can predict which prism of its activity will be inspected. Honest agents rest in a lagoon of calm predictability: their work is real, audits pass, deposits release. But a sybil army of thousands faces constant random scrutiny, and keeping every puppet's story straight under audit costs far more than any reward, so mass forgery becomes economically irrational.
